sources.locator: "Battle of the Tugela Heights", revision 1376503813, lead and § Background

explanation: The later record’s own cited article says it in its lead: "General Sir Redvers Buller’s British army forced Louis Botha’s Boer army to lift the Siege of Ladysmith." Its § Background says what the battle was the fourth of: "Buller’s army had made three earlier attempts to raise the Boer siege of Ladysmith... On 12 February, Buller ordered a fourth attempt to relieve Ladysmith." `reacted-to`, the same reading as the third attempt at Vaal Krantz a week earlier: the siege is what this battle was fought to end, not something that produced it. `probable` rather than `consensus`, because the only source the atlas can open here is the encyclopaedia article itself (rule 22).
